detail.longDescription: This is the Eleventy Decap Starter Kit that I have been working on over the last few weeks. It's built on Web Awesome components and has design tokens synced from the design file, fluid type and spacing, Decap CMS for editors, and accessibility, HTML and link checks on every commit. Strict pull-request workflow: protected main, required checks before anything merges. https:// git.frede.dev/stefanfrede/11ty -decap-starter-kit # Eleventy # 11ty # WebAwesome # Accessibility # a11y # WebDev
